desc: The PWS MK1 MOD 2-M pistol series, boasting the renowned PWS long-stroke piston system for unparalleled reliability. While maintaining the core integrity of other PWS lines, the MK1 MOD 2-M offers a suite of exclusive features tailored to elevate your shooting experience. At the forefront is the patent-pending PicLok technology integrated into the free float handguard, providing users with the versatility to mount either Picatinny or MLOK accessories with ease. Crafted from fully forged upper and lower receivers, the impeccable craftsmanship of this rifle is immediately apparent. Enhancements such as the elimination of the forward assist, inclusion of a flared mag well, and built-in trigger guard, among other precision add-ons, distinguish the MK1 MOD 2-M, setting a new standard for premium firearms. With its sleek design, compact form factor, and unwavering performance, the MK1 MOD 2-M excels both aesthetically and in action, ensuring satisfaction in every aspect of use.
